title: Dual-Track Fight Prep Visualization
subtitle: Technical program and coaching layer integrated with Gym Eyes
key_concept: Two parallel tracks—technical and psychological—unified by Gym Eyes for holistic fight preparation
visual_metaphor: A cathedral nave with two parallel aisles: one lined with boxing gear (gloves, bags), the other with coaching tools (mirrors, scripts), converging at an altar with a glowing eye
highlights: Technical program (top) and coaching layer (bottom) run simultaneously
Gym Eyes feeds both tracks, ensuring integration
why_it_matters: Established a new system for fight prep that merges physical and mental training into a single visual framework
zone_change: Crossed from isolated technical drills to integrated mind-body preparation
